mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1100) and residential sales (RSAFS < 450000) indicate weakening consumer demand for major purchases, triggering negative equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1100 and RSAFS < 450000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 reflect strong consumer confidence in major purchases, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through increased spending momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000.

mechanism_narrative: CPI year-over-year growth exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) reduce wage pressures and corporate cost structures, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through improved profit margins.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 16400) indicate broad economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue streams, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 105 and GDPC1 < 16400.
